learning_outcomes.text: Implement quality management systems in mechatronic products and processes.
Design a machine starting from a solid model that will allow the user to produce virtual models, simulations, calculations, manufacturing plans, and bills of materials for the sub-assemblies.
Perceive planning as an important stage between design and manufacturing.

assessment_rules: To pass "Mechanical Design and Manufacturing II", students must pass all three local Master's subjects. The final grade is calculated as 0.6 * PROT + 0.2 * SSM + 0.2 * PROY. If a student does not pass all three local subjects, the final grade will be FAIL, and the numerical grade will be the weighted average or 4.0 (whichever is lower). If a student does not attend all local subject exams, their final grade will be NOT PRESENTED (NP) or FAIL depending on attendance, with participation in at least 50% of activities obliging a grade.
bibliography: Access to Mechatronics Classroom equipment: Power supply, Oscilloscope, Function generator, Programming and debugging tools for microcontrollers, PCs with class software, Electronic components, Workbench equipped with drill, soldering iron, wrenches, pliers, etc.
